urls.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) is the central bank of the European Union countries which have adopted the euro. Our main task is to maintain price stability in the euro area and so preserve the purchasing power of the single currency.
urls.title: How the sovereign debt crisis shaped wealth inequality in the euro area

data.text:
The sovereign debt crisis led to an increase in wealth inequality in the euro area. Inequality has slowly returned to pre-crisis conditions. 

Yet, its effects are still felt and visible today in the countries most severely affected by the crisis https://t.co/yjWzKegfDK https://t.co/9cvgsqlgvM

urls.title: The role of refining costs and margins in HICP energy inflation

data.text:
There’s more to energy inflation than crude oil alone.

Supply disruptions have pushed up refining costs and margins, especially for diesel. We examine how these pressures feed through to inflation via transport and heating fuel prices.

urls.description: The Milky Way is old enough to have been settled many times over, yet we see no sign of anyone. An AI built a model and ran 22 studies of public data. The evidence rules out one explanation, and the rest depends on what you assume. No person has checked the numbers, and no outside expert has reviewed it.

data.text:
